# appwrite_function_deployment_activation (Action)

Makes an existing deployment the active one for a function. Useful for rolling back to a known-good deployment without rebuilding it, which is a decision taken at a moment rather than a piece of desired state.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The ID of the deployment to activate.
- `function_id` (String) The ID of the function.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.
